messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: I encounter an error when installing an r-package (ggplot2) from github.
parts:
Start by running: dev_mode() - if it doesn't work and you are on
windows, you need to install Rtools
(http://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/Rtools/)

Hadley
